Løn og rammer Lønrammen for stillingen er 46.000-55.000 kr. om måneden + pension, afhængigt af erfaring og kompetencer. Kontoret ligger i Silkeborg, og rollen kræver, at du kan være fysisk til stede på kontoret de fleste dage. Company: CKYORPLUS Job Locations: Bangalore | Indore | Visakhapatnam Salary: Up to ₹15,000 per month Job Type: Full-time, On-site Working Days: 6 days per week About CKYORPLUS CKYORPLUS is a CCTV security solutions company specializing in IP cameras, Wi-Fi cameras, 4G cameras, solar cameras, and other surveillance products. We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated freshers who want to build their careers and grow with our organization. Open Positions 1. CCTV Camera Repair Technician – Fresher Diagnose, test, and repair CCTV cameras and related hardware. Troubleshoot basic electronic, PCB, power, and connectivity issues. Assist with camera testing, component replacement, and quality checks. Candidates with an ITI, diploma, or background in Electronics or Electrical are preferred. 2. Sales Executive – Fresher Communicate with customers, dealers, and distributors. Explain CCTV products, generate leads, and follow up on enquiries. Support sales activities and maintain customer records. Good communication skills and a positive attitude are essential. 3. Technical Support & Networking Engineer – Fresher Assist with CCTV camera installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. Work with IP cameras, NVRs, routers, switches, and LAN networks. Help resolve technical issues and provide customer support. Basic knowledge of computers, networking, or electronics is preferred. 4. Junior Accountant – Fresher Maintain sales, purchase, billing, and payment records. Assist with invoices, expense tracking, and account reconciliation. Work with Excel and accounting software such as Tally. Candidates with a B.Com or related qualification are preferred. Eligibility Freshers are welcome to apply. Relevant educational qualifications are preferred depending on the role. Willingness to learn, a responsible attitude, and good communication skills are important. Training will be provided to suitable candidates wherever required. How to Apply? 📧 Email your CV: admin@ckyorplus.net 📱 WhatsApp your CV: +91-7869081340 Join CKYORPLUS and build your career with us!
